title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: No behaviour changes. The quick fix that drops an unread field from a data class cuts inside a line, and one of the three bounds that decide where was held by nothing.

highlights.title: Removal Bounds Now Pinned
highlights.description: Breaking the bound that eats a middle parameter's comma passed the whole suite while emitting a doubled comma on eleven removals of a real project. The tests now read the Kotlin that comes out of the cut.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Two harnesses check every removal against a real project rather than a fixture, and both were shown to fail first on a deliberately shifted bound.
On 85 declaration removals and 11 field removals they report nothing.
